scripts.dev: pnpm ensure-env && pnpm --filter @vardia/shared build && pnpm --parallel --filter @vardia/api --filter @vardia/web dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm ensure-env && pnpm --filter @vardia/shared build && pnpm --filter @vardia/api dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @vardia/shared build && pnpm --filter @vardia/api build && pnpm --filter @vardia/web build
